paragraphs.text: Pontotoc Middle School has scheduled its Family Campfire Evening for 4–6 p.m. Thursday, Oct. 29, in the school’s sixth-grade break area. The event is for fifth- and sixth-grade students and their families.

The school’s announcement lists s’mores, roasted marshmallows, hot chocolate, music, relay games and spooky stories. It describes the evening as a chance for parents and teachers to spend time together.
Students should go home after school as usual and return with their families for the event. Families are encouraged to bring a chair. The school’s full notice and flyer are linked below.
